mapper.select:
select count(*) from assignment ass
join student_course sc on ass.course_no = sc.course_no
left join assignment_submit s on ass.assignment_no = s.assignment_no and s.student_no = #{studentNo}
where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status = '수강중' and ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp ) and s.submit_no is null

select * from ( select ass.assignment_no, ass.course_no, c.course_title, ass.assignment_title,
case when ass.assignment_status = '마감' or ( ass.assignment_due_date is not null and systimestamp >= ass.assignment_due_date ) then '마감' else '제출가능' end as assignment_phase,
ass.assignment_due_date
from assignment ass
join course c on ass.course_no = c.course_no
join student_course sc on ass.course_no = sc.course_no
left join assignment_submit s on ass.assignment_no = s.assignment_no and s.student_no = #{studentNo}
where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status = '수강중' and ass.assignment_status = '게시' and ( ass.assignment_due_date is null or ass.assignment_due_date > systimestamp ) and s.submit_no is null
order by ass.assignment_due_date asc nulls last, ass.assignment_no desc )
where rownum <= 5

select count(*) from exam e
join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no
where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status = '수강중' and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end

select count(*) from exam e
join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no
where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status = '수강중' and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp < e.exam_start

select * from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title,
case when e.exam_status = '마감' or systimestamp >= e.exam_end then '종료'
when systimestamp < e.exam_start then '예정'
else '응시가능' end as exam_phase,
e.exam_start, e.exam_end
from exam e
join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no
join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no
where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status = '수강중' and e.exam_status = '공개' and e.exam_end > systimestamp
order by case when systimestamp >= e.exam_start and systimestamp < e.exam_end then 1 else 2 end, e.exam_start asc, e.exam_no asc )
where rownum <= 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_course sc JOIN course c ON sc.course_no = c.course_no JOIN schedule s ON c.course_no = s.course_no WHERE sc.student_no = #{studentNo} AND sc.student_course_status = '수강중' AND s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AND c.course_status = '진행중'

SELECT c.course_no AS courseNo, c.course_title AS courseTitle, c.course_subject AS courseSubject, g.grade_level AS gradeLevel, NVL(act.account_name, '미지정') AS tutorName, s.schedule_start || ' ~ ' || s.schedule_end AS scheduleInfo, NVL(cs.classroom_no, s.classroom_no) || '호' AS classroomInfo, s.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, s.schedule_start AS scheduleStart, s.schedule_end AS scheduleEnd, NVL(cs.classroom_no, s.classroom_no) AS classroomNo, cs.session_no AS sessionNo, cs.session_status AS sessionStatus, c.course_current_count AS courseCurrentCount, c.course_limit AS courseLimit FROM student_course sc JOIN course c ON sc.course_no = c.course_no JOIN schedule s ON c.course_no = s.course_no LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.grade_no = g.grade_no LEFT JOIN employee e ON c.employee_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN account act ON e.account_no = act.account_no LEFT JOIN class_session cs ON s.schedule_no = cs.schedule_no AND TRUNC(CAST(cs.session_start AS DATE)) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) WHERE sc.student_no = #{studentNo} AND sc.student_course_status = '수강중' AND s.schedule_week = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AND c.course_status = '진행중' ORDER BY s.schedule_start ASC

select s.student_no, a.account_name as student_name
from parent_student ps
join student s on ps.student_no = s.student_no
join account a on s.account_no = a.account_no
where ps.parent_no = #{parentNo}
order by s.student_no asc
